If you use an iPhone 16 or newer model, you may want to find a Qi2.2 charger so your device can take full advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging speed it supports. Anker's newly launched 25W Prime MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is a great choice, featuring an extremely portable design.

First Impressions

The major trend in the second half of 2025 is bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and this trend continues into 2026. Anker is leading the way with a brand-new portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger, integrating 25W Qi2.2 support into an extremely portable design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost essential. Nearly every 25W charger on the market comes equipped with this feature, and Anker's new foldable 3-in-1 charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and a USB-C cable, sufficient to charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this charging stand, you can charge your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you once loved this product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you'll probably love this one. It's nearly as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two major advantages: it can be used as a stand, and it can charge three devices simultaneously instead of two.

This charger has a rather interesting (though admittedly somewhat unnecessary) feature—the Apple Watch charger uses a spring-loaded design. When you fold the charger closed, it retracts inward; but when you're ready to open it, you just need to press it once, and it pops out. I find this design quite clever and it also helps justify the product's premium price.

Conclusion

Overall, if you're looking for a stylish and portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger, this new Anker product is an excellent choice. Thanks to its built-in active cooling, it can quickly charge your iPhone without overheating or causing the other side effects that wireless charging sometimes brings.

Anker's new 3-in-1 MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for US$99, with free shipping for Prime members, in black and white color options.
